# Calendar drag eligibility and item accessibility remain separate contracts

The current event-item drag handler rejects unwritable calendars, items the user cannot modify and invitations. It normalizes a text-node event target before finding a draggable ancestor, then selects the item before building drag data. The task tree separately rejects absent or read-only items. Item selection updates aria-selected and focus; the item exposes role option and an accessible title. Preserve those states when changing drag handling. Existing tests check dates and identities after mouse drags, not keyboard move alternatives or screen-reader announcements. The native drag test temporarily relaxes one accessibility event rule, which is not proof that all drag interaction is accessible.

Scope: calendar-drag.
